column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:array-util module
# Loadable module of APL-style array utilities. Import binds the
# `ArrayUtil` namespace, then words are called via dot-access:
# `"aql:array-util" import end  ArrayUtil.word args`. The everyday array
# words (iota/range/take/shed/each/fold/...) stay in core; this module

column3: shape: the length along each axis (2 rows, 3 cols)
rank: the number of axes
reshape: lay flat data into the given shape
transpose: swap rows and columns of a rank-2 list

column1: aql:array-util import end  ArrayUtil.where [true false true false true]
column3: where: indices of the truthy elements
grade: indices that would sort the list ascending
at: select data elements by an index list
replicate: repeat each element by its count

column1: aql:array-util import end  ArrayUtil.expand [true false true] [7 8]
column3: expand: spread data into true slots, 0 into false slots

column1: aql:array-util import end  ArrayUtil.compress [true false true] [1 2 3]
column3: compress: keep data where the mask is true
member: is each needle present in the haystack
unique: distinct elements, first-seen order
indices: position of each needle in the haystack, -1 if absent
group (1-arg): map each value to the indices where it occurs
group (2-arg): bucket values by their parallel key
window: all contiguous slices of the given width
pairs: consecutive overlapping 2-tuples
eachrank: apply a body at cell-rank 0 (each scalar leaf)
foldaxis 0: reduce down each column
foldaxis 1: reduce along each row

column1: # §6  negative — a namespace word is undefined until the module is imported

column3: `ArrayUtil` is unbound without `import`
